description: Create the requested single-platform tracking group; does not establish populated or fresh evidence. A group with the same name (trimmed, case-insensitive), platform and locale_key is returned instead of a duplicate, with reused_existing=true. Use socialseal_list_tracking_groups to find the saved group and socialseal_get_tracking_group_completeness to inspect its membership.

locale_key.description: Optional language-market key such as en-SG; part of the group identity.

workspaceId.description: Authorized workspace for this requested write; discover accessible context first.

name: socialseal_create_tracking_group

fieldPaths.description: Deduplicated JSON pointer patterns (* matches array elements) into source payloads before text truncation and existing structuredContent.result or structuredContent. Original structured values are unchanged.
